newsitem.title: USA: Carriage Services merges with Forest Lawn.
newsitem.headline: Carriage Services merges with Forest Lawn.

text.p: Carriage Services Inc, the nation's fifth largest publicly traded funeral company, has an agreement in principle to merge with Forest Lawn/Evergreen Management Corp of Panama City, Florida.
Carriage Service made the announcement Friday but did not disclose terms of the deal, which it said should close in September, subject to a definitive merger pact.
Forest Lawn owns and operates three cemeteries and one funeral home in Panama City and funeral homes in Fort Walton Beach, Florida, and Dothan, Alabama.

Carriage Services said the two principal shareholders of Forest Lawn, Greg Brudnicki and Charles Kent, will remain active in the business and become significant shareholders of Carriage and join the Carriage board.
Carriage Services said Brudnicki and Kent will also be active in expanding the company's southeast presence.
Carriage Services owns and operates 101 funeral homes and 12 cemeteries in 18 states, as of June 30.
